# ScienceBlogs

> > A collaborative science communication platform featuring expert analysis and discussion of cutting-edge research in astronomy, astrobiology, space exploration, and planetary science.

ScienceBlogs serves as a hub for scientific discourse, with particular emphasis on NASA missions like OSIRIS-REx and James Webb Space Telescope discoveries, exoplanet research, and the search for extraterrestrial life. The platform connects researchers, science communicators, and the public through featured articles and ongoing scientific discussions.

## Key Topics

- NASA missions and space exploration
- OSIRIS-REx asteroid sample return mission
- Bennu asteroid research
- James Webb Space Telescope observations
- Exoplanet discovery and characterization
- TWA 7 b and other exoplanetary systems
- PSR B1257+12 pulsar planets (Poltergeist, Phobetor)
- Astrobiology and life detection
- Space telescope technology
- Asteroid research and planetary defense
- Human-animal interaction studies
- Featured science articles and analysis

## Main

- [ScienceBlogs - Where the world discusses science.](https://scienceblogs.com): Homepage featuring NASA, OSIRIS-REx, James Webb Telescope & exoplanet news
